title: collomia grandiflora f. axillaris
intro: Collomia grandiflora f. axillaris, commonly known as the large-flowered collomia, is a flowering plant species within the Polemoniaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions. The bioactive constituents of Collomia grandiflora f. axillaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, contributing to its therapeutic effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
